about: Identity's network messages (rule 7): signing in (with a password, or again with the token a page kept) and out, and an admin's accounts (the admin page). (Who may open a project is read and set through Projects' routes, protocol/projects.contract.json.) The server half registers exactly these routes (server/stilo/modules/identity/adapters/routes.py); only the browser half (app/modules/identity/adapters/api.js) calls them. Raise the version when a message changes in a way an older browser cannot read.
